title: atlas.entity.rename.v1 — arguments
description: Supply at least one of display_name or also_known_as; a rename that changes nothing is invalid-argument rather than a silent no-op.

also_known_as.description: Replaces the entire nickname list when supplied. Omit to leave it unchanged.

entity_id.description: Minted once, never re-derived, and never reused. An id Atlas returned resolves forever.
